registry_layers.source_of_truth: checked-in network dependency resolution fixture bound to hosted registry endpoint, fixture lock, trust root, offline mirror, and cache signature

registry_layers.source_of_truth: checked-in package release-channel publication contract bound to network resolution proof, stable channel freshness, lock, trust, provenance, and cache pins

publication_rules: registry metadata must be generated from the lock and mirror evidence
publication metadata may not introduce package identities absent from the lock graph
registry metadata must preserve package manifest digests, language version, ABI identity, and trust signatures from the lock
local registry indexes must preserve exact locked target versions, dependency source authority digests, dependency source digests, package manifest digests, and replay commands
interop loader metadata must fail closed when the mirror digest differs from the generated lock
offline restore receipts must fail closed when any mirror cache entry is missing, extra, or digest-mismatched
hosted-registry behavior must fail closed unless it is the checked-in offline fixture contract with endpoint identity, channel identity, lock/trust material, cache policy, and explicit failure modes

network dependency resolution must fail closed unless it is the checked-in offline fixture contract with endpoint identity, exact locked version, fixture lock digest, trust root, provenance, cache signature, and no fallback registry success

package release-channel publication must fail closed when channel freshness is stale, lock/trust/provenance drift, cache tamper, dependency identity drift, or hosted registry endpoint mismatch is detected
package registry publication must not activate release or registry trust roots until installer/update keys and extraction path safety are source-backed and reviewed
release and update metadata may reference package ecosystem artifacts only as generated local evidence
offline mirror publication must remain usable without network access

registry_publication_owner.claim_boundary: local generated registry metadata only; hosted registry availability and package-manager parity are release-blocking overclaims
